explanation:
The bug was in `/work/repo/lib/netrc.c` in the `parsenetrc` function. When a username is provided in the URL (`specific_login` is true), the code was returning the password from a .netrc entry even when the login in that entry didn't match the URL username (`our_login` is false).

The root cause is at line ~330 where the success condition was simply `if(!retcode)`, which didn't check whether the login matched when a specific login was requested.

The fix changes the success condition from:
```c
if(!retcode) {
```
to:
```c
if(!retcode && (!specific_login || our_login)) {
```

This ensures:
- When no username is in the URL (`specific_login` is false), we return the password for the machine entry (existing behavior)
- When a username is in the URL (`specific_login` is true), we only return the password if the .netrc entry's login matches that username (`our_login` is true)

The fix passes the bug check (now exits 1 instead of 0) and all 22 related project tests pass.
